sentences.en: The Goblin King looked at the children.
sentences.zh: 这小妖怪国王看在这孩子们。

sentences.en: His small eyes glinted and he snapped his long, thin fingers.
sentences.zh: 他的小的眼睛闪光和他啪的一声他的长的， 瘦的手指。

sentences.en: "How do you want to die?" He asked, said Hong.
sentences.zh: 如何做你想要到帝俄？ 爸爸问。

sentences.en: "That is the right answer," Said the Goblin King.
sentences.zh: 那个是这正确的回答， 说这小妖怪国王。

sentences.en: «We want to die of old age," said Hong.
sentences.zh: «我们想要到帝俄的旧的年龄， 说吽。

sentences.en: "So I must let you go."
sentences.zh: 我必须让你去。

sentences.en: He opened the door of the cage.
sentences.zh: 他打开这门的这笼子。

sentences.en: "Brilliant," Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 明亮的！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Brilliant!" said Chip.
sentences.zh: 明亮的！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "But how did you know the right answer?"
sentences.zh: 但是如何做你知道这正确的回答？

sentences.en: "I don't know," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说吽。

sentences.en: "I just did."
sentences.zh: 我刚刚做。

sentences.en: "Let's find the next riddle," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 让我们找到这下一个谜语， 说 Ty。 帮助！ 说 Ty。 不， 说 Biff。 哦！

sentences.en: "The goblins still have the magic key," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这小妖怪仍然有这魔法钥匙， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We must get it back."
sentences.zh: 我们必须得到它回来。

sentences.en: "Give us back our key," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 给我们回来我们的钥匙， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "No," "No," said a goblin.
sentences.zh: 哦不！

sentences.en: "We won't."
sentences.zh: 我们不会。

sentences.en: "Give it back!" Shouted Chip.
sentences.zh: 给它回来！ 喊 Chip。 停它！ 喊 Chip。

sentences.en: "Make us!" Called the Goblins.
sentences.zh: 做它停！ 做我们！ 叫这小妖怪。

sentences.en: Hong had an idea.
sentences.zh: 吽有一个主意。

sentences.en: He spoke to the Goblin King.
sentences.zh: 他说到这小妖怪国王。

sentences.en: Hong said.
sentences.zh: 伥！ 说 Kim。

sentences.en: "All right," "We will ask you a riddle," Hong said.
"You must give us back the key if you can't answer it."
sentences.zh: 你必须给我们回来这钥匙如果你不能回答它。

sentences.en: "All right," said the Goblin King.
sentences.zh: 全部正确的， 说这小妖怪国王。

sentences.en: "What is the riddle?"
sentences.zh: 什么是这谜语？

sentences.en: Hong wrote in the sand, "One plus one equals six."
"Make this work by drawing a straight line," He said.
sentences.zh: 吽写在……里这沙， 做这个工作由图画一个直的线， 他说。 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: The goblins scratched their heads.
sentences.zh: 这小妖怪划破他们的正面。

sentences.en: At last, they said, "We can't do it." Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他们说。

sentences.en: Hong put a line on the 'plus'.
sentences.zh: 吽放一个线在……上这 '加'。

sentences.en: "One, and one, and four add up to six!" "Very clever," Said the Goblin King.
sentences.zh: 一， 和一， 和四补充向上到六！

sentences.en: And he gave Biff the key.
sentences.zh: Biff 这钥匙。

sentences.en: The children went on.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们去在……上。

sentences.en: At last, they came to a flat desert.
sentences.zh: 在最后的， 他们来到一个水平的抛弃。

sentences.en: There were strange shapes in the sky.
sentences.zh: 那里是奇怪的形状在……里这天空。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the shapes flew down and whizzed over the children's heads.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这形状飞向下和飕飕飞过在……上方这孩子们正面。

sentences.en: "Ouch! Said Ty.
sentences.zh: 哎哟！ 帮助！ 说 Ty。

sentences.en: That one hit me," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 那个一击我， 说 Ty。

sentences.en: The flying shapes were kites.
sentences.zh: 这飞形状是风筝。

sentences.en: The kites dived at the children.
sentences.zh: 这风筝跳水在这孩子们。

sentences.en: "What is the answer to this riddle?"
sentences.zh: 但是第一回答这个谜语。

sentences.en: Shouted the kite flyer.
sentences.zh: 看出！ 喊 Kipper。

sentences.en: "I can be cracked.
I can be played.
sentences.zh: Nadim 来到玩。

sentences.en: I can be told.
sentences.zh: Nadim 来到玩。

sentences.en: I can be made.
sentences.zh: 我能得到我的爸爸到缝补它'

sentences.en: What am I?"
sentences.zh: 什么是我？

sentences.en: "I know this one," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个一， 说吽。

sentences.en: "The answer is a joke."
sentences.zh: 这回答是一个笑话。

sentences.en: The kite flyer let them pass.
sentences.zh: 这风筝 flier 让他们通过， 但是下一个他们来到一个宽阔的河。

sentences.en: But next, they came to a wide river.
sentences.zh: 他们来到一个河。

sentences.en: "We can never cross this," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们能从不叉形这个， 说 Chip。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "It's too deep and dangerous."
sentences.zh: 它是也深的和危险的。

sentences.en: Then they saw an old man on a raft.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看见一个旧的男人在……上一个筏子。

sentences.en: "But first answer this riddle.
sentences.zh: 但是第一回答这个谜语。

sentences.en: I have seven children.
sentences.zh: 我有七孩子们。

sentences.en: Half of them are boys.
sentences.zh: 一半的他们是男孩。

sentences.en: How can this be?"
sentences.zh: 如何能这个是？

sentences.en: "I will take you across the river."
sentences.zh: 我将拿你穿过这河。

sentences.en: "That is right," said the old man.
sentences.zh: 那个是正确的， 说这旧的男人。

sentences.en: "I know the answer," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我知道这回答， 说吽。

sentences.en: "All your children are boys." "That's right," "That is right," said the old man.
sentences.zh: 全部你的孩子们是男孩。 那是正确的， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "I will take you across the river."
sentences.zh: 我将拿你穿过这河。

sentences.en: "How do you know the answer to all the riddles," Ty asked Hong.
sentences.zh: 如何做你知道这回答到全部这谜语， Ty 问吽。

sentences.en: "I don't know," Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说吽。

sentences.en: "The answer's just come to me."
sentences.zh: 这回答刚刚来到我。

sentences.en: The children came to a dark, gloomy forest.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们来到一个黑暗的， 阴暗的为了。

sentences.en: The trees were bent and twisted.
sentences.zh: 这树是弯曲的和弯曲的。

sentences.en: "What a scary place," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么一个可怕的地方， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I can see eyes looking at us."
sentences.zh: 我能看见眼睛看在我们。

sentences.en: Suddenly, wolves sprang out of the trees.
sentences.zh: 突然地， wolves sprang 出的这树。

sentences.en: They had red eyes and long, sharp, white teeth.
sentences.zh: 他们有红色的眼睛和长的， 尖的， 白色的牙齿。

sentences.en: "They're after us," yelled Chip.
sentences.zh: 他们是在……之后我们， 叫喊 Chip。 看出！ 叫喊 Chip。

sentences.en: "Run!"
sentences.zh: 跑！

sentences.en: The children ran fast, but the wolves were faster.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们跑快的， 但是这 wolves 是快的。

sentences.en: "Quick!" Yelled Biff.
sentences.zh: [音乐]。 快的！ 叫喊 Biff。

sentences.en: "Climb a tree."
sentences.zh: 爬一个树。

sentences.en: The children climbed quickly, but Hong was a bit slow.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们爬快速地， 但是吽是一个一小块慢的。

sentences.en: A wolf sprang up at him.
sentences.zh: 一个狼 sprang 向上在他。

sentences.en: The wolf snapped at Hong.
sentences.zh: 这狼啪的一声在吽。

sentences.en: It sank its teeth into his bag and pulled it off his back.
sentences.zh: 它 sank 它的牙齿进入他的包和拉它离开他的回来。

sentences.en: "Help!" Yelled Hong.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 叫喊吽。

sentences.en: Then a strange woman came out of the trees.
sentences.zh: 然后一个奇怪的女人来出的这树。

sentences.en: The wolves ran up to her.
sentences.zh: 这 wolves 跑向上到她。

sentences.en: The Wolf Woman told the wolves to sit.
sentences.zh: 这狼女人告诉这 wolves 到坐。

sentences.en: She told the children to climb down.
sentences.zh: 她告诉这孩子们到爬向下。

sentences.en: "Answer this riddle," The Wolf Woman picked up Hong's bag, but she gave it to Ty.
sentences.zh: 回答这个谜语， 它说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "It lives half its life.
sentences.zh: 它住一半它的生命。

sentences.en: It dies half its life.
sentences.zh: 它死一半它的生命。

sentences.en: It dances to no music.
sentences.zh: 它跳舞到不音乐。

sentences.en: It drinks with no mouth." "That's easy," This time, Ty knew the answer.
sentences.zh: 它喝和……一起不嘴。 那是容易的， 他说。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "It's a tree." "Good," "Good," said the Wolf Woman.
sentences.zh: 它是一个树。 好的。

sentences.en: "The next riddle is at Riddle Mountain.
sentences.zh: 这下一个谜语是在谜语山。

sentences.en: No one has ever got it right."
sentences.zh: 不一有在任何时候得到它正确的。

sentences.en: The children went on.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们去在……上。

sentences.en: Then Biff said, "Hong has known the answers to all the riddles, but not the last one.
sentences.zh: 然后 Biff 说， 吽有知道这回答到全部这谜语， 但是不这最后的一。

sentences.en: Why?" "I don't know," Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 为什么？ 我不知道， 说吽。

sentences.en: "It's strange," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是奇怪的， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: By now they were at Riddle Mountain.
sentences.zh: 由现在他们是在谜语山。

sentences.en: At the top was a cave.
sentences.zh: 在这顶是一个洞穴。

sentences.en: "The last riddle will be up there," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 这最后的谜语将是向上那里， 说 Ty。 帮助！ 说 Ty。

sentences.en: "Come on!"
sentences.zh: 来在……上！

sentences.en: "Oh, what a climb," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么一个爬！ 说 Chip。 哦！

sentences.en: They climbed up to the cave.
sentences.zh: 他们爬向上到这洞穴。

sentences.en: "I'm tired."
sentences.zh: 我是累的。

sentences.en: "Let's have a rest," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 让我们有一个休息， 说 Ty。 帮助！ 说 Ty。

sentences.en: The children sat down.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们坐向下。

sentences.en: Ty took off Hong's bag.
sentences.zh: Ty 拿离开轰包。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the ground began to shake.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这地面开始到抖动。

sentences.en: A stone statue rose up out of the earth.
sentences.zh: 一个石块雕像 rose 向上出的这地球。

sentences.en: The statue opened its hand and spoke.
sentences.zh: 这雕像打开它的手和说。

sentences.en: "Who answers this riddle, will be the Riddle Maker!" It said.
sentences.zh: 谁回答这个谜语， 将是这谜语做！ 它说。 它是一个风筝。

sentences.en: "This is the riddle," Said the statue.
sentences.zh: 什么是这谜语？ 这个是这谜语， 说这雕像。

sentences.en: "If the answer I give is 'yes', but what I mean is 'no', then what is the question?"
sentences.zh: 我给是 '是'， 但是什么我意思是是 '不'， 然后什么是这问题？

sentences.en: Everyone looked at Hong. Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 每个人看在吽。 不， 说伥。

sentences.en: "Neither do I," Said Ty sadly.
sentences.zh: 我， 说 Ty 悲伤地。

sentences.en: "I don't know the answer," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这回答， 说吽。

sentences.en: "We failed," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们是朋友们。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Wait!" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么'， 呃。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I have an idea!" He asked, said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我有一个主意！ 爸爸问。

sentences.en: "Where is that stone with the Chinese writing?"
sentences.zh: 哪里是那个石块和……一起这中国的写？ 他问。

sentences.en: "It's in my bag," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 它是在……里我的包， 说吽。

sentences.en: "Ty knew the Wolf Woman's riddle and he had Hong's bag," said Biff.
sentences.zh: Ty 知道这狼女人谜语和他有轰包， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。 哦！

sentences.en: "Maybe whoever has the stone can answer riddles," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 也许的人有这石块能回答谜语， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Ty took the stone out of the bag.
sentences.zh: Ty 拿这石块出的这包。

sentences.en: "I know the answer to the question," he said.
sentences.zh: 我知道这回答到这问题， 他说。

sentences.en: "It is 'Do you mind?"
sentences.zh: 它是 '做你头脑？

sentences.en: Ty put the stone in the statue's hand.
sentences.zh: Ty 放这石块在……里这雕像手。

sentences.en: "It is the right answer," said the statue.
sentences.zh: 它是这正确的回答， 说这雕像。 这个是这谜语， 说这雕像。

sentences.en: "You are the new Riddle Maker."
sentences.zh: 你是这新的谜语做。

sentences.en: Just then the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 刚刚然后这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The adventure was over. Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 这冒险是在……上方。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "So we knew the answer all along," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道这回答全部沿着， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "It was on the stone."
sentences.zh: 它是在……上这石块。

sentences.en: "Well, I didn't want to be the Riddle Maker," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我没有想要到是这谜语做， 说吽。 不， 说伥。

sentences.en: "Did you?" "No," "No," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 做你？ 哦不！ 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "And I never want to hear another riddle."
sentences.zh: 我从不想要到听见另一个谜语。
